 JOB OBJECTIVE	
Dynamic and results-driven Business Systems Analyst with a robust focus on treasury and risk management, targeting to leverage extensive experience in regulatory reporting and product ownership within the banking and finance sectors.
 PROFILE SUMMARY	
Business Analysis & Product Leadership: Gained over 15 years of progressive IT experience, including 9 years in Business Analysis and Product Ownership roles and 6 years in manual and automation testing, delivering business-critical solutions across treasury, risk, and regulatory technology domains.
Treasury & Risk Management Expertise: Possess deep domain expertise across Treasury Management Systems (TMS), Corporate Treasury, Risk Management, OTC Derivatives, Liquidity Management, Cash Forecasting, In-House Banking, Multilateral Netting, STP, CLS, and Trade Lifecycle Management, enabling effective alignment of technology solutions with business objectives.
Global Regulatory Reporting SME: Established as a trusted subject matter expert for OTC Derivatives Regulatory Reporting, driving compliance and reporting transformation initiatives across EMIR, FCA, CFTC, ESMA, ISO 20022 MX Formats, Collateral Reporting, and Valuation Reporting frameworks.
Strategic Product Ownership & Roadmap Execution: Directed product backlog governance, requirements prioritization, and roadmap execution, enhancing delivery predictability and stakeholder satisfaction through value-driven Agile planning and execution.
Large-Scale Regulatory Transformation Leadership: Successfully led the delivery of EMIR and FCA REFIT programs, orchestrating cross-functional teams and enabling the seamless migration and go-live of 40+ global clients while maintaining 100% regulatory compliance within mandated timelines.
Innovation & Platform Modernization: Spearheaded the development of a configuration-driven, no-code integration and packaging framework, reducing deployment effort, accelerating implementation timelines, and enhancing solution scalability across enterprise environments.
Stakeholder Engagement & Enterprise Collaboration: Built strong partnerships across Treasury, Risk, Compliance, Product Management, Engineering, QA, Architecture, and Client organizations, translating complex regulatory and business requirements into high-impact enterprise solutions.
Operational Excellence & Process Optimization: Championed workflow automation, approval process modernization, exception handling improvements, and process standardization initiatives, driving enhanced governance, operational efficiency, and user adoption across multiple product modules.
Agile Delivery & Business Impact: Showcased leadership in Scaled Agile environments by managing multi-team programs, release planning, UAT governance, and business sign-offs, consistently delivering high-quality solutions that improved customer experience, reduced operational risk, and strengthened regulatory readiness.

Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration testing, defect resolution, and release readiness for mission-critical financial platforms.
